subject: Private deployment — controlpath fallback and rollback plan
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@novamed.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PROD VPC controlpath stall after agent update — urgent

Hi Hannah,

We had a scheduled agent upgrade in our private VPC overnight (agent v1.9.3 -> v1.10.0). Since ~07:00 PDT we are seeing control-plane RPCs intermittently stall for tens of seconds which is causing spikes in request latency and a handful of 5xx errors for inference calls. This started right after the cluster upgrade.

Attached are the logs from the host side (controlpath-logs-0927.txt). Our ops team is standing by and we'd like to know whether Redwood can: 1) advise immediate mitigation steps, or 2) perform an emergency rollback to the previous agent version.

This is impacting our scheduled clinician-facing batch processing (non-critical, but customer-facing). We need a clear rollback/mitigation plan and an ETA. Please escalate — we need to keep the window small.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director of Platform Operations
NovaMed Health
ops@novamed.com
(415) 555-0198

--
Attachment: controlpath-logs-0927.txt (text/plain, 1.2MB)
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novamed.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2027 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PROD VPC controlpath stall after agent update — immediate triage & rollback options

Elena — thank you for the logs and the heads up. We’ve opened internal ticket RED-4729 and I’ve looped in Ben and Karthik from infra. Initial read: the controlpath health checks are timing out during leader election handoffs after the agent started reporting a different metadata schema.

Immediate plan:
- We can roll the agent back to v1.9.3 across your controlplane hosts; estimated completion 30–45 minutes once we have your go-ahead and a short maintenance window.
- As a mitigation we can temporarily route traffic to your read-only replicas to reduce user-visible errors while we do the rollback (expect slight added latency).

Please confirm: are you available to approve a 30-minute maintenance window at 12:00 PDT today? If so, we will push the rollback and run the rollback-checklist-20270928.pdf steps (pre-checks, snapshot, rollback, post-checks). I will stay on the call during the operation.

We will also produce an incident postmortem and a SOC2-friendly evidence bundle after the incident.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Subject: Re: PROD VPC controlpath stall — rollback plan and test steps

Hannah / team — quick tech summary and what we'll do in the 12:00 window if approved: 

Summary:
- Root cause (prelim): agent v1.10.0 introduced a metadata handshake change that fails when controlpath leader election overlaps with ephemeral mgmt channel resets. The result is delayed heartbeats and temporary unresponsiveness. No data corruption indicated.

Rollback steps (high level):
1) Snapshot current controlplane config (takes ~3 mins).
2) Drain controlplane hosts (graceful stop).
3) Reinstall agent v1.9.3 and validate checksums.
4) Restart services with warm leader election (we'll force a stable leader).
5) Run functional smoke tests against a small traffic slice for 10 minutes.
6) Bring traffic back gradually, monitor metrics.

Estimated timeline: 30–45 minutes. Risk: low for data integrity; medium for short transient availability during switch. We will keep your replicas serving to reduce user impact.

I’ve attached the checklist (rollback-checklist-20270928.pdf) and added the commands we will run to the shared runbook.

— Ben Carter
Software Infrastructure Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Thanks, Hannah and Ben. Please proceed with the rollback at 12:00 PDT. We authorize the 30–45 minute maintenance window. Ops will place a small banner to notify internal users and pause the scheduled clinician batch at 11:55.

A few asks before you start:
- Please confirm whether any audit logs or message queues will be truncated during rollback (we need to preserve evidence for our compliance team).
- Can you include an initial incident summary and an expected timeline for a formal postmortem delivery? Our security/compliance lead will expect evidence that access and changes are tracked.

Elena

Subject: Re: Private deployment — controlpath fallback and rollback plan — completed

Elena — follow-up after rollback and verification (summary):

Status: Completed (12:00–12:36 PDT, 2027-09-28)
What we did:
- Rolled agents from v1.10.0 -> v1.9.3 on all controlplane hosts per rollback-checklist-20270928.pdf.
- Snapshots of config and controlplane state taken prior to changes (stored in runbook link below).
- Ran smoke tests for 15 minutes against a 10% traffic slice, then ramped to full. Metrics returned to expected baselines (latency median back to normal; error rate returned to baseline).

Impact: brief availability window during switch; no data loss detected. Audit logs and change history are preserved — we uploaded the evidence bundle for SOC2 review.

Next steps and deliverables:
- Postmortem draft: https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/PrivateDeployments/NovaMed/postmortem-20270928.md (we will share a SOC2-friendly bundle and a timeline of the RCA by 2027-10-05).
- Action items: Ben will propose a compatibility gate for agent upgrades (automated schema validation + canary schedule); Karthik to add an automated alert that fires on prolonged leader election (>10s).
- We will offer a one-week service credit for the customer-facing impact; account team will follow up with commercial terms.

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute readout with your compliance/security team next week to go through the evidence bundle.

Thanks for the rapid coordination — we’ll keep you posted as we finalize the postmortem.

— Hannah Schmitt
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
